messages:
emily: @channel Short heads-up: on 2026-05-01 were enforcing org SAML SSO and flipping CI to the Redwood-managed self-hosted runner fleet (label: redwood-runner). Purpose: central access control + predictable costs. No app feature changes expected, but repos will need to reauthorize certain integrations. See migration guide: https://internal.redwood/devex/ci-sso-cutover (checklist + steps).

raj: Are there special instructions for machine/service accounts that currently use PATs?

emily: Yes. Preferred path: switch to OIDC where supported. For anything that cannot use OIDC, create a managed service account via the new service-account flow (docs linked). We will SCIM-provision service accounts to GitHub as members with restricted team membership.

infra-bot: scheduled: prepare-runner-fleet job started (2026-04-20T02:00:00Z) -> creating initial pool in us-east-1.

artemis: For GitHub Actions workflows, do we need to change runs-on? Example please.

emily: For most, very small edits. Example in the guide (snippet):

```yaml
# before
runs-on: ubuntu-latest
steps:
  - uses: actions/checkout@v3
  - run: ./ci/build.sh

# after
runs-on: [self-hosted, redwood-runner]
steps:
  - uses: actions/checkout@v3
  - name: build
    run: ./ci/build.sh
```

ben: Our Jira -> PR linking uses the legacy app. Will that stop working?

emily: Were migrating to the modern GitHub <-> Jira integration. During your repos migration window youll get a prompt to reauthorize the Jira app; well run a 72-hour overlap so metadata continues to flow. Reauth is one click and we DM repo admins with instructions.

security: A couple of policy notes: SSO enforcement will follow the company IdP MFA rules (Okta). We will audit token usage and rotate any long-lived PATs for humans and machines that remain. Exemptions for legacy appliances require a security ticket and justification.

raj: Timeline? Will there be forced rotation of PATs?

emily: Timeline: canary group 2026-04-27, broader rollout 2026-05-01, forced rotation for leftover repo PATs on 2026-05-15. If you need an extension, file the migration-delay form in the guide by 2026-04-22.

infra-bot: reminder: migration docs updated (v2.0) -> https://internal.redwood/devex/ci-sso-cutover#checklist

claire: Any expected CI downtime or queue spikes during cutover?

emily: No planned downtime. Well keep runners warm and autoscaling tuned. We expect a small bump in queue latency for cold-started runners; monitor the rollout dashboard (link in guide). Well pause rollouts if errors > 2% in canary.

raj: Will audit logs show which runner executed a job? Need that for compliance.

emily: Yes  runner IDs, job metadata, and GitHub actor will be recorded in central audit logs and forwarded to Splunk for 180 days.

ben: Thanks. Ill plan a dry-run for our product repo next week.

emily: Thanks all  office hours daily 9:00-10:00 PT in #devex-help from 2026-04-23 through 2026-05-02. Please raise blockers early. :rocket:
